newsitem.title: LEBANON: Shares steady on Beirut Stock Exchange.
newsitem.headline: Shares steady on Beirut Stock Exchange.

text.p: All active shares held steady on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Tuesday on highly increased turnover.
Total BSE turnover was 226,909 shares up from Monday's 142,603. Value rose to $2,469,162 from $1,291,833.
Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce traded at Monday's $14.25 and Banque Audi at $19.125.
A total of 30,000 Audi shares and 2,500 BLC shares were traded in two separate blocks on the floor at $19.125 and $14.25 respectively.
Solidere A shares held steady at Monday's $10.25 and B shares at $10.75. Total turnover in the company's shares was 126,383 shares from 99,393 with heavy supply on A shares
The LIBX bank index held steady at 121.17, the BLOM stock index at 905.93 and the LISPI at 85.55.
Turnover in industrial pipemaker Eternit nearly doubled with 41,200 shares traded against Monday's 22,850 at the unchanged price of $2.0312.
Some 100 shares of Ciments Libanais were traded at $1.21875 compared with 9,445 shares on Monday.
There was no trade in the two other listed firms: Ciments Blancs and Uniceramic.
